extension.description: Stremio for Kodi program addon with embedded Nimbus Home and media information. Nimbus layouts and artwork by Ivar Brandt. Kodi remains the playback engine; the global Kodi skin is unchanged.
extension.news:
1.0.59: Fix Continue Watching regression: remove watched/90%+ movies, keep completed series hidden until an aired next episode is verified, and rebuild the SQLite CW index automatically.
1.0.58: SQLite-backed Continue Watching for all series, MKGA server-side subtitle resolver/cloud cache, Noiro-style fast subtitle translation path, and Kodi API networking fixes.
1.0.57: Remove Premium UI, add MKGA subtitle sync status/Sync Now, and support Orange subtitle color from MKGA.TV.
1.0.56: Make MKGA.TV Account the recommended subtitle settings source while preserving a full This device - Local fallback and keeping Gemini keys local.
1.0.55: Sync MKGA.TV subtitle preferences in the background, including language priority, AI behavior and Kodi subtitle style.
1.0.51: Prevent legacy-profile migration failures from blocking startup/sign-in, and add an optional native Kodi Search keyboard for Yatse/Kore and physical/Bluetooth keyboard users.
